name: AD828 (ADI low-power dual video op-amp)
tagline: ADI's 130 MHz, 450 V/µs dual video op-amp; Chinese sound-card and car-audio modders rate it above the AD827 for dynamics and treble extension.
technology: Bipolar voltage-feedback dual video op-amp (process details not confirmed this pass). ADI says it is a low-cost dual optimised for video applications that need gains of +2 or more and high output drive, such as cable driving. Its relation to the AD826 / AD827 / AD847 dies is unconfirmed.

reputation.summary: The praise comes from Chinese DIY sources. A CSDN listening ranking of 22 classic op-amps credits the AD828AN with 'jump, grandeur, extension' but a somewhat rough midrange, and ranks it above the AD827. An Elecfans topic page says the AD828AR beats the AD827JN and calls it neutral, with good mid resolution, strong bass dynamics and clear, extended highs; it recommends the part for sound-card and DVD output stages. Car-audio modders on Autohome fit it to head units. One Bilibili creator found a cheap AD828 board disappointing. There is no Western audiophile or measurement-based consensus.
typical_uses: Op-amp swaps in car head units
Vendor-intended use: video line and cable drivers at G >= +2
caveats: This is a video op-amp that ADI optimises for gains of +2 or more. In unity-gain buffer or socket-swap positions it may ring or oscillate, so check stability and decoupling.
The praise is subjective and comes mostly from Chinese forums and marketing-style pages. One Bilibili review was negative.
The PDIP AD828AN appears to be discontinued, so DIP parts sold on marketplaces may be new-old stock or remarked.

claims_confirmed: The AD828 is ADI's 'Dual, Low Power Video Op Amp', a low-cost dual optimised for gains of +2 or more and cable driving (https://www.analog.com/en/products/ad828.html).

Specs: 130 MHz -3 dB bandwidth at G = +2, 450 V/µs slew, 0.1 dB flatness to 40 MHz, differential gain/phase 0.01%/0.05°, 15 mA supply current, 50 mA minimum output per amplifier (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/AD828.pdf).
The current ADI datasheet is Rev. C (https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/ad828.pdf).
AD828ARZ is listed as in production (https://octopart.com/ad828arz-analog+devices-411908).
AD828AN appears in ADI PDN 10_0081 Rev. B, according to the search summary (https://www.analog.com/media/en/pcn/ADI_PDN_10_0081_Rev_B_Form.pdf).
